newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes low on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes low on dollar demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed soft as speculative demand for dollars depressed the local currency, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.55 to the dollar after opening at 57.47. The rupee closed at 57.48 on Thursday.
"Commercial demand was minimal, but speculation took the dollar up," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates closed at 13 percent, after opening at 15.5 percent, with the market well offered, dealers said.
Forex and money markets were dull due to it being the last day of the month, they said.
